```lean
import CategoryTheory.Adjunction
import CategoryTheory.Monads.Algebras

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂}
  [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} C]
  [CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₂} D]
  {G : CategoryTheory.Functor D C}
  {F : CategoryTheory.Functor C D}
  (adj : F ⊣ G)
  (A : adj.toMonad.Algebra) :
  G.IsSplitPair (F.map A.a) (adj.counit.app (F.obj A.A)) := by
  let T := adj.toMonad
  let μ := T.μ
  let η := T.η

  let X := A.A
  let f : F.obj X ⟶ G(F.obj X) := F.map A.a
  let g : G(F.obj X) ⟶ X := adj.counit.app (F.obj X)

  -- We want to show that g ∘ f = id_{F.obj X} and f ∘ g = id_{G(F.obj X)}

  -- First, show g ∘ f = id_{F.obj X}
  have h1 : g ∘ f = id (F.obj X) :=
    by
      rw [← adj.unit_app X]
      erw [CategoryTheory.naturality_left (adj.unit) (F.obj X)]
      erw [adj.counit_naturality (F.obj X) (F.obj X)]
      erw [adj.unit_naturality (F.obj X) (F.obj X)]
      erw [CategoryTheory.id_comp]
      erw [CategoryTheory.comp_id]
      rfl

  -- Now, show f ∘ g = id_{G(F.obj X)}
  have h2 : f ∘ g = id (G(F.obj X)) :=
    by
      rw [← adj.counit_app X]
      erw [CategoryTheory.naturality_right (adj.counit) (F.obj X)]
      erw [adj.unit_naturality (F.obj X) (F.obj X)]
      erw [adj.counit_naturality (F.obj X) (F.obj X)]
      erw [CategoryTheory.id_comp]
      erw [CategoryTheory.comp_id]
      rfl

  exact G.IsSplitPair.mk f g h1 h2
```
